factions.name: British Commonwealth
additionalRules: Bombardment - When rolling for Preparatory Bombardment, roll 2 Dice instead of 1; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 144
Artillery Support - Gain Access a Second, Free, Regular Forward Artillery Observer; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 144

A National Characteristic - Gain Access to one of the following:
 • Up and at 'em - Any Run Order on a Regular or Veteran to Assault it automatically successful.
 • Blood Curdling Charge - Enemy units cannot react to an Assault by shooting at them if the unit is Regular or Veteran.
 • Tough as Boots - Regular or Veteran Infantry Units roll bonus attack dice when in Close Quarters.
 • Rapid Fire - All Regular and Veteran Infantry units with rifles roll bonus attack dice when shooting.
 • Vengeance - Regular and Veteran Units can make a test to lose one pin marker if an enemy is within 12in.
 Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 144-145

factions.name: Chinese People's Volunteer Army
additionalRules: Conscript Levy - Gain access to a free Conscript Rifle Squad; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 166
Sparrow Tactics - Regular and Veteran Infantry may make a move of 8in after both sides have finished setup, before first turn; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 166
Flag - A unit can equip a flag to gain Rally to the Colors; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 166
Short Attack - When an Officer uses 'You men Snap to', they can only select infatry units and are limited to one extra dice; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 166

factions.name: North Korean People's Army
additionalRules: At All Costs - When an Infantry or Artillery Unit fails a morale check and would be destroyed, take the test again. Must accept the second result; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 76
Conscript Levy - Gain access to a free Conscript Rifle Squad; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 76
Not One Step Back! - Gain access to a Commissar; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 76
Flag - Gain access to Rally to the Colors rule by replacing weapons with a flag; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 76

factions.name: Republic of Korea
additionalRules: Tae Guk Gi - If the enemy force includes KPA Units, all your Infantry and Artillery Units gain Fanatic; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 97
Conscription - May include a free Conscript Rifle Squad; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 97

Defensive Posture - In missions that have an Attacker/Defender, there is a reroll if ROK is not Defender. If ROK is Defender, gain the following:
 • First turn, opponent cannot issue Run orders.
 • Reroll for Artillery or Smoke barrage once.
 • Any ROK units that are Hidden may start with an Ambush.
 • Gain access to D3 emplacements after determining table edges.
 Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 97

factions.name: United States of America
additionalRules: Helicopters - Forward Observers can gain either Reconnaissance, Aerial Observation, or Medevac; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 115
Fire and Manuever - US Infantry Units do not suffer the -1 to hit; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 115
Gyro-Stabilisers - Veteran Tanks do not suffer -1 to hit; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 115
Air Superiority - Forward Air Observers can call in an Air Strike Twice per game; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 115
Modern Communications - When moving from Reserve to table, do not suffer -1 to Order Test; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 115
KATUSA Recruits Language Barrier - Units with KATUSA Recuirts start the game with a pin for each KATUSA Recruit the squad contains; Bolt Action Korea Rules Book, Pg. 115
